in_marathi.name: Akalya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akalya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Akala’, meaning ‘immeasurable time’ or ‘timeless’. Akalya is a name with spiritual significance and is used to denote someone who transcends the boundaries of time.

vedic_reference.note: Akalya is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Akalpārkam, Akalpam, and Akalam, which mean immeasurable, timeless, and endless. This name is also mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and mythology, such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas.
